title: Kconfig: Duplicate LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION config definition
description: Lines 103-111 and 125-133 both define config LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION with identical content. This is a copy-paste error. Kconfig behavior with duplicates is undefined - typically the second silently overrides the first, but can cause build warnings, menuconfig display issues, or symbol resolution problems depending on toolchain version.
close_reason: Fixed: Removed duplicate config LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION definition at lines 125-133, keeping the first definition at lines 103-111
